title: E2E executor schema
description: Test package build outputs via npm pack + tarball install.

packageDir.description: Path to built package directory relative to workspace root (e.g., dist/libs/logging). Defaults to dist/{projectRoot}.

testDir.description: Path to E2E test project directory relative to workspace root. Defaults to the current project root.

formats.description: Output formats to test. 'browser' runs combined IIFE/UMD tests against the DOM preload. Defaults to cjs, esm, and browser.

skipInstall.description: Skip npm pack and install step (useful if already installed).
